definition: Gaussian Error Linear Unit, a smooth activation function that weights inputs by their value under a standard normal cumulative distribution.
details: GELU is used in many transformer models, including BERT and GPT variants, because its smooth curve tends to improve optimization compared to ReLU.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is GELU.
